86a1903adb53184fa1a8470d5f6fba7fa7b13d6e.summary: Trend Micro's TrendLabs blog describes Dexter (detected as BKDR_DEXTR.A), an infostealer reportedly found on point-of-sale systems at hotels and other businesses. It collects data such as usernames, hostnames, OS information and running processes, and sends it to a remote server. Unlike ZeuS/ZBOT and SpyEye, it targets POS systems rather than users' own machines. How it arrives on those systems is undetermined.
